title_en: Yingshang County People's Procuratorate, Anhui Province v. Gong Detian — traffic accident crime
ruling_gist_en: In cases of causing a traffic accident, the act of fleeing that has already been used as an element for conviction cannot be repeatedly evaluated as a sentencing circumstance for aggravated punishment.
keywords_en: criminal; causing traffic casualties; second instance; intermediate people's court; Anhui Province; natural person; criminal law; whether flight is repeatedly evaluated; flight as element for conviction or as aggravating circumstance; amended judgment; traffic accident; flight; voluntary surrender; compensation and settlement
full_text_en:
Yingshang County People's Procuratorate, Anhui Province v. Gong Detian — crime of causing a traffic accident

Ruling Summary

In a criminal case of causing a traffic accident, the act of flight that has already been used as an element for conviction may not be re-evaluated as a circumstance for aggravating the punishment of the defendant.

Procuratorial Authority: Yingshang County People's Procuratorate, Anhui Province.

Defendant: Gong Detian, who voluntarily surrendered to the Yingshang County Public Security Bureau, Anhui Province on June 10, 2014 for this case, was criminally detained the next day, arrested on June 24, executed on the following day, and released on bail pending trial on July 3.

The Yingshang County People's Procuratorate, Anhui Province filed a public prosecution with the Yingshang County People's Court, Anhui Province, charging the defendant Gong Detian with the crime of causing a traffic accident.

The indictment alleged: At approximately 15:00 on June 10, 2014, the defendant Gong Detian, while speeding, drove a white Jianghuai-brand truck (license plate Wan K5XXXX) from west to east on Road X041 and collided with a Suzuki-brand two-wheeled motorcycle (license plate Wan KGXXXX) driven north to south by the victim, Zhang, who was unlicensed, at the Tangzhuang crossroad in Zhanglou Village, Saijian Township, Yingshan County. The accident damaged both vehicles and caused the death of the victim, Zhang, at the scene. A forensic examination determined that the victim died from severe craniocerebral injury caused by the traffic accident. According to the accident liability determination issued by the Yingshang County Traffic Management Brigade, the defendant Gong Detian bore primary liability for the accident. After the incident, Gong Detian compensated the victim's close relatives RMB 326,000 and obtained their forgiveness. Gong Detian, while driving a motor vehicle on a public road in excess of the speed limit, violated laws and regulations on traffic administration, thereby causing a major accident resulting in one death, and bore primary liability for the accident. His conduct violated Article 133 of the Criminal Law of the PRC, and he should be held criminally liable for the crime of causing a traffic accident. Furthermore, Gong Detian fled after causing the accident, and the procuratorate recommended a sentence of not less than three years but not more than four years of fixed-term imprisonment.

The defendant Gong Detian admitted that his traffic accident caused the death of Zhang, but argued that he did not flee after the accident.

The Yingshang County People's Court, Anhui Province found at the first instance:

At approximately 15:00 on June 10, 2014, the defendant Gong Detian, while speeding, drove a white Jianghuai-brand truck (license plate Wan K5XXXX) from west to east on Road X041 in Yingshang County and collided with a Suzuki-brand two-wheeled motorcycle (license plate Wan KGXXXX) driven north to south by the victim, Zhang, who was unlicensed, at the Tangzhuang crossroad in Zhanglou Village, Saijian Township, Yingshan County. The accident damaged both vehicles and caused the death of Zhang at the scene. After the accident, Gong Detian called the 122 police hotline to report the incident and then abandoned the vehicle and left the scene. At 21:50 on the same day, Gong Detian voluntarily surrendered to the Traffic Management Brigade of the Yingshang County Public Security Bureau, where he truthfully confessed the facts of the crime. A forensic examination confirmed that Zhang died from severe craniocerebral injury caused by the traffic accident. According to the road traffic accident liability determination issued by the Traffic Management Brigade of the Yingshang County Public Security Bureau, Gong Detian's driving speed exceeded the maximum speed limit on the accident section, and he abandoned the vehicle and left the scene after the accident. His conduct violated Article 70, Paragraph 1 of the Road Traffic Safety Law of the PRC and Article 45, Paragraph 2 of the Regulations for the Implementation of the Road Traffic Safety Law of the PRC, and was the direct cause of the traffic accident, for which he bore primary liability. Zhang, driving a motor vehicle without a license, failed to ensure safety when passing through the intersection and did not yield to vehicles approaching from the right, violating Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Road Traffic Safety Law of the PRC and Article 52, Item 2 of the Regulations for the Implementation of the Road Traffic Safety Law of the PRC, which was an indirect cause of the traffic accident, for which he bore secondary liability. After mediation, Gong Detian entered into a settlement agreement with the close relatives of the victim, Zhang, and compensated them for all economic losses totaling RMB 326,000, obtaining their forgiveness.

The above facts were confirmed by the following evidence: the police dispatch registration form, household registration certificate, driver's license, motor vehicle information inquiry sheet, surrender explanation, accident liability determination, death certificate, mediation agreement, compensation voucher, forgiveness letter, call records, community impact assessment opinion, testimony of witnesses Jiang Wei, Chen Dengran, Ou Xihu, and Zheng Tianxuan, judicial expert opinion, forensic autopsy report, accident scene inspection and examination records, site map, scene photographs, and synchronized audio-video recordings. The evidence was sufficient to establish the facts.

The Yingshang County People's Court, Anhui Province held at the first instance:

The defendant Gong Detian, while driving a motor vehicle on a public road in excess of the speed limit, violated laws and regulations on traffic administration, thereby causing a major accident resulting in one death, and bore primary liability for the accident. Moreover, he fled after the accident. His conduct has violated the criminal law and constitutes the crime of causing a traffic accident, for which he should be punished. The charges brought by the Yingshang County People's Procuratorate against Gong Detian for the crime of causing a traffic accident were clear in fact, sufficient in evidence, and well-founded. After fleeing the accident, Gong Detian voluntarily surrendered to the public security authorities on the same day and truthfully confessed the facts of the crime, which constitutes voluntary surrender, entitling him to a lighter or mitigated punishment according to law. Additionally, Gong Detian actively compensated the close relatives of the victim for their economic losses and obtained their forgiveness, which may be considered as a circumstance for a lighter punishment at discretion. Considering the community impact assessment opinion regarding Gong Detian rendered by the judicial authorities, applying a suspended sentence to Gong Detian would not have a significant adverse impact on the community where he resides, and a suspended sentence may be applied according to law.

Accordingly, pursuant to Article 133, Article 67, Paragraph 1, and Article 72, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the PRC, and Article 2, Paragraph 1, Item 1 and Article 3 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Traffic Accidents, the Yingshang County People's Court, Anhui Province rendered the following judgment on November 6, 2014:

The defendant Gong Detian is convicted of the crime of causing a traffic accident and sentenced to three years of fixed-term imprisonment, suspended for four years.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, the defendant Gong Detian, dissatisfied with the judgment, filed an appeal with the Fuyang Intermediate People's Court, Anhui Province, arguing that he had voluntarily called the police and dialed 120 emergency services immediately after the incident, and left the scene out of fear of being beaten by the victim's relatives, not as an act of flight. He further argued that he had voluntarily surrendered, actively compensated the victim's relatives for their economic losses, and obtained their forgiveness. He contended that the original sentence was too harsh and requested a lighter sentence from the second instance court.

Upon trial at the second instance, the Fuyang Intermediate People's Court, Anhui Province confirmed the facts found in the first instance.

The issue in dispute in this case was: whether the act of the appellant Gong Detian in abandoning his vehicle and fleeing after the traffic accident was an element for his conviction for the crime of causing a traffic accident or an aggravating circumstance for punishment for that crime.

The Fuyang Intermediate People's Court, Anhui Province held at the second instance:

With respect to the appellant Gong Detian's grounds of appeal, upon examination: (1) In this case, an anonymous call from mobile number 130XXXX1199 was made to 110 at 15:51 on June 10, 2014, while Gong Detian used his mobile number 158XXXX8866 to call 122 at 16:16 on the same day. He did not immediately call the police at the earliest opportunity after the accident. (2) He stated in his confession that after calling the police, he did not promptly surrender because he feared being detained by the police station. (3) After calling the police, he abandoned the vehicle and left the scene, did not wait at the scene for the public security authorities to handle the matter, turned off his mobile phone, and the traffic police could not contact him after arriving at the scene. In summary, it is sufficient to establish that after the accident, he left the scene to evade legal accountability. Although he later surrendered to the public security authorities, his subsequent termination of the flight does not affect the determination of his act of flight. As for his voluntary surrender, compensation to the victim's relatives for economic losses, and receipt of forgiveness, these circumstances were all recognized in the original judgment. Accordingly, his grounds of appeal cannot be sustained and are not adopted.

With regard to the original judgment that the appellant Gong Detian, while driving a motor vehicle on a public road in excess of the speed limit, violated laws and regulations on traffic administration, thereby causing a major accident resulting in one death, bore primary liability for the accident, and fled after the accident, and that his conduct constituted the crime of causing a traffic accident, and sentenced him to three years of fixed-term imprisonment, suspended for four years, pursuant to Article 133, Article 67, Paragraph 1, and Article 72, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the PRC, and Article 2, Paragraph 1, Item 1 and Article 3 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Traffic Accidents, upon examination: According to Article 133 of the Criminal Law of the PRC and Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Traffic Accidents, for a traffic accident resulting in one death, the actor must also bear full or primary liability for the accident in order to be convicted of the crime of causing a traffic accident. In this case, the traffic police department determined that Gong Detian bore primary liability for the accident precisely on the basis that he drove a motor vehicle in excess of the speed limit and abandoned the vehicle and left the scene after the accident. That is, Gong Detian's act of abandoning the vehicle and leaving the scene was an element of his conduct constituting the crime of causing a traffic accident. Therefore, the original judgment, by applying Article 3 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Traffic Accidents, determined that Gong Detian's conduct constituted the crime of causing a traffic accident and that he fled after the accident. This clearly constitutes a repeated evaluation of his act of flight, which is an error in the application of law and should be corrected according to law. Gong Detian, in violation of laws and regulations on traffic administration, drove a motor vehicle on a public road in excess of the speed limit, thereby causing a major accident resulting in one death, and after the accident abandoned the vehicle and left the scene, for which he bore primary liability. His conduct has constituted the crime of causing a traffic accident and should be punished according to law. The facts found in the original judgment were clear, the evidence was sufficient and reliable, the conviction was accurate, and the trial procedure was lawful. However, there was an error in the application of law, and the judgment should be amended according to law.

Accordingly, pursuant to Article 133, Article 67, Paragraph 1, and Article 72, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the PRC, Article 2, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Traffic Accidents, and Article 225, Paragraph 1, Item 2 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, the Fuyang Intermediate People's Court, Anhui Province rendered the following judgment on November 27, 2014:

1. The criminal judgment (2014) Ying Xing Chu Zi No. 00473 rendered by the Yingshang County People's Court, Anhui Province, i.e., the defendant Gong Detian was convicted of the crime of causing a traffic accident and sentenced to three years of fixed-term imprisonment, suspended for four years, is vacated.

2. The appellant (original defendant) Gong Detian is convicted of the crime of causing a traffic accident and sentenced to one year of fixed-term imprisonment, suspended for two years.

This judgment is final.
